phase: Phase 5 — Hierarchical Multi-Model Intrusion Detection Engine (FCS-HMD)

components.general_threat_detector: LightGBM Deployable Subset (14 features, calibrated sigmoid probabilities)
components.tenant_anomaly_detector: Isolation Forest & Autoencoder Anomaly Detectors (pure benign calibration)
components.ddos_specialist: LightGBM DDoS Specialist (calibrated volumetric attack classifier)
components.scanning_specialist: LightGBM Scanning Specialist (SYN & reconnaissance probe detector)
components.botnet_specialist: Documented as NOT_ELIGIBLE for FlowEvent v1 (lacks payload DNS & jitter features)
components.model_router: ConditionalModelRouter (24.9 us p95 overhead, feature/prob triggers)
components.evidence_fusion: EvidenceFusionEngine (deterministic Bayesian weights + rule safety floor)
components.bundle_manager: DetectionBundle & BundleValidator with SHA-256 seal and atomic rollback
components.soc_dashboard: React 18 / TypeScript Model Monitoring Page with HMD Topology Visualizer

G15.1_model_score_contract.name: ModelScore v1 Standardized Contract
G15.1_model_score_contract.evidence: Immutable ModelScore dataclass, probability bounds [0.0, 1.0], calibrated confidence, and network_action_executed = False invariant verified.

G15.2_anomaly_baseline.name: ISP-Specific Anomaly Detection (Isolation Forest & Autoencoder)
G15.2_anomaly_baseline.evidence: Trained solely on benign tenant traffic; sigmoid calibrated anomaly probabilities; zero cross-tenant contamination verified.

G15.3_attack_specialists.name: Eligible Attack Specialists (DDoS & Scanning)
G15.3_attack_specialists.evidence: DDoS specialist (PR-AUC: 0.9167), Scanning specialist (PR-AUC: 0.8931) evaluated; Botnet specialist evaluated and documented as NOT_ELIGIBLE due to FlowEvent v1 schema limits.

G15.4_conditional_router.name: Conditional Model Router & Eligibility Check
G15.4_conditional_router.evidence: Short-circuits benign baseline without specialist invocations (latency: 24.9 us p95); volumetric burst routes DDoS; SYN probe routes Scanning specialist.

G15.5_evidence_fusion.name: Deterministic Multi-Model Evidence Fusion
G15.5_evidence_fusion.evidence: Tested across Level 1 fusion, specialist dominance, deterministic rule risk floors, and missing/timeout fallback modes.

G15.6_uncertainty_and_abstention.name: Uncertainty Quantification & Explicit Abstention
G15.6_uncertainty_and_abstention.evidence: Threshold margin (|p - th| < 0.05) marks status as ABSTAIN; composite uncertainty tracked in forensics; missing models never hallucinate benign scores.

G15.7_bundle_management.name: DetectionBundle Validation & Authorized Rollback
G15.7_bundle_management.evidence: BundleValidator blocks tampered checksums; authorized activation restricted to TENANT_ADMIN / PLATFORM_ADMIN; atomic bundle rollback verified.

G15.8_reliability_budgets.name: Specialist Timeout & General-Only Fallback
G15.8_reliability_budgets.evidence: Timed-out and faulted specialists produce degraded telemetry without breaking Level 1 general threat detection pipeline.

G15.9_soc_integration.name: FastAPI Services & React Dashboard Integration
G15.9_soc_integration.evidence: Multi-model score attribution, routing decisions feed, ISP anomaly baselines, and bundle rollback exposed via REST API and rendered in React SOC dashboard.

G15.10_safety_and_zero_cost.name: Manual Response Invariant & Zero-Cost Compliance
G15.10_safety_and_zero_cost.evidence: network_action_executed = False invariant verified; AUTO mode disabled; ₹0.00 spent across all training, inference, and benchmarks on local CPU.
